# SFINCS Entity Contributor License Agreement

> **DRAFT v0.1 for review by Deltares Legal. Not yet in force.**
> Structure adapted from the Apache Software Foundation Corporate CLA (Software Grant and Corporate Contributor License Agreement).
> The outbound-licensing clause (section 2.3) and the past-contributions clause (section 1, "Contribution") are Deltares additions.

This Agreement is between Stichting Deltares, Boussinesqweg 1, 2629 HV Delft, the Netherlands (KvK number [TO BE FILLED IN]) ("Deltares"), and the organisation named below ("You" or "the Entity").

It allows the Entity's employees and contractors listed in Schedule A to contribute to SFINCS on the Entity's behalf. It must be signed by a person authorised to bind the Entity. Each listed individual also accepts the SFINCS Individual CLA, or is covered by this Agreement alone where Deltares and the Entity agree so in writing. [LEGAL: decide whether individuals covered by an entity agreement must also sign the individual CLA.]

## 1. Definitions

**"You"** means the Entity signing this Agreement, together with all entities that control it, are controlled by it, or are under common control with it. "Control" means direct or indirect ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting securities, or the power to direct management by contract or otherwise.

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any modifications or additions to an existing work, that is submitted to Deltares by You or by any of Your Designated Contributors (Schedule A) for inclusion in, or documentation of, SFINCS or any other project owned or managed by Deltares under the name SFINCS (the "Work"). This includes source code, documentation, test cases, configuration files, figures and examples. "Submit" means any form of electronic, verbal or written communication sent to Deltares or its representatives, including pull requests, patches, issue comments containing code, and e-mail, but excluding communication conspicuously marked as "Not a Contribution". **This Agreement applies to all Contributions submitted before it was signed as well as all Contributions submitted afterwards, including those listed in Schedule B.**

## 2. Copyright licence

2.1 Subject to the terms of this Agreement, You grant Deltares, and recipients of software distributed by Deltares, a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright licence to reproduce, prepare derivative works of, publicly display, publicly perform, sublicense and distribute Your Contributions and such derivative works.

2.2 This licence covers all forms of exploitation, including forms not yet known when this Agreement is signed, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

2.3 **Outbound licensing.** Deltares may distribute Your Contributions, alone or as part of the Work, under any licence terms of its choice, including open-source licences other than the licence the Work is distributed under when the Contribution is submitted, and including proprietary or commercial licences. Deltares will keep making the Contributions available under at least one licence approved by the Open Source Initiative for as long as Deltares distributes the Work as open source. [LEGAL: same choice as in the individual CLA.]

2.4 You keep the copyright in Your Contributions. Except for the licences granted in this Agreement, You reserve all right, title and interest in and to Your Contributions.

## 3. Patent licence

Subject to the terms of this Agreement, You grant Deltares, and recipients of software distributed by Deltares, a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable (except as stated in this section) patent licence to make, have made, use, offer to sell, sell, import and otherwise transfer the Work. This licence applies only to those patent claims that You can license and that are necessarily infringed by Your Contribution(s) alone, or by combining Your Contribution(s) with the Work to which they were submitted. If any entity starts patent litigation against You or any other entity (including a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit), alleging that Your Contribution, or the Work to which You have contributed, constitutes direct or contributory patent infringement, then all patent licences granted to that entity under this Agreement for that Contribution or Work end on the date that litigation is filed.

## 4. Your representations

4.1 You represent that You are legally entitled to grant the above licences, and that each Designated Contributor is authorised to submit Contributions on Your behalf.

4.2 You represent that each of Your Contributions is Your original creation, or that of Your Designated Contributors (see section 6 for submissions on behalf of others).

4.3 You represent that, to Your knowledge, Your Contributions do not infringe any third party's copyright, patent, trade secret or other intellectual property right.

## 5. Designated Contributors

5.1 You will keep Schedule A up to date by notifying sfincs@deltares.nl when a Designated Contributor is added or removed. A removal applies only to Contributions submitted after the notification.

5.2 It is Your responsibility to inform Your Designated Contributors of this Agreement.

## 6. Work that is not Your own

If You wish to submit work that is not Your original creation, You may submit it to Deltares separately from any Contribution. Identify the complete details of its source and of any licence or other restriction (including related patents, trademarks and licence agreements) that You know of, and conspicuously mark the work as "Submitted on behalf of a third party: [named here]".

## 7. No obligations

7.1 You are not expected to provide support for Your Contributions, except to the extent You wish to. Unless required by applicable law or agreed in writing, You provide Your Contributions on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, express or implied, including any warranties or conditions of TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

7.2 Deltares is under no obligation to include any Contribution in the Work.

## 8. Notification

You agree to notify Deltares (sfincs@deltares.nl) of any facts or circumstances You become aware of that would make these representations inaccurate in any respect.

## 9. Governing law and jurisdiction

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Netherlands. Any dispute arising from or in connection with this Agreement will be submitted exclusively to the competent court in The Hague, the Netherlands. [LEGAL: confirm court.]

## 10. Changes to this Agreement

Deltares may publish new versions of this Agreement. A new version applies only to Contributions submitted after You have signed that new version.
